title: Custom Steel Staircase Fabrication
summary: Design, fabrication and installation of a blackened steel feature staircase with oak treads for a lobby renovation.

sections.heading: Materials
sections.body: Hot-rolled steel stringers with a blackened patina finish, solid white oak treads, and a mild steel handrail.

sections.body: Shop fabrication over four weeks, followed by a two-day on-site installation coordinated with the general contractor.
